facebook.caption: Tourists stick to the main strip. The ones who know, end up at Passion Pub & Sports Bar in Cửa Lấp. 4.8 stars. 351 reviews. A bar this good has no business being this under the radar. Cold drinks, good energy, and a crowd that actually lives here. $15-30 a person. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
